newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish currency reserves rise to $18.9 bln in May.
newsitem.headline: Polish currency reserves rise to $18.9 bln in May.

text.p: Polish official foreign currency reserves grew by $463 million in May to $18.9 billion and were $898 million higher than a year ago, the National Bank of Poland said.
It said official reserves grew $879 million in the January-May period compared to a $3.054 billion rise in the corresponding period of last year.
POLISH RESERVES (bln dollars) MAY APRIL MAY 96
NOTE - Figures in billions of dollars. Official reserves are those held by the state. Net reserves mean the total amount of hard currencies in the whole banking system.
